newsitem.title: ITALY: Consob asks Olivetti for further details.
newsitem.headline: Consob asks Olivetti for further details.

text.p: Italy's stock market watchdog Consob said on Thursday it had asked troubled high-tech group Olivetti for further details on its first half 1996 balance sheet, as well as details of its financial situation up to the end of August.
Consob said it had asked for further information in a statement issued after a meeting at its Rome headquarters with Olivetti managers and auditors.
Today's meeting was called by Consob to try to clarify the seven points that the watchdog wants answered about the group's first half financial accounts.

Consob said it had asked Olivetti to supply further information about "various aspects relevant to the half-yearly accounts statement" and to "assure the comparability of this statement with that of the previous six months."
It also requested details about the evaluation criteria used by management in the accounts concerning the relationship between the parent company and its holdings.
Consob also asked Olivetti to give details about its financial situation up to August 31.
Olivetti's auditors had been asked to give specific affidavits on all the aspects Consob had indicated.
Consob said Olivetti should supply the information requested directly to the market. It said it hoped this would happen as soon as possible.
